correctness.rationale: Taylor multipliers t_ν=c Πλ_j^{ν_j} diagonalize the operator. A unit-modulus monomial gives a linear-drift pseudotrajectory that cannot be traced. For a mixed/neutral coordinate, a high-degree sequence ν_k has bounded |t_νk| and |ν_k|/k→∞; one-time polynomial pulses of uniformly small compact-open norm force an alleged tracing vector to violate Cauchy bounds on a larger polydisk. In uniform contraction, finitely many low Taylor modes are hyperbolic and corrected by stable/unstable Green series; the high-order tail contracts under iterates and the corrections converge on every polydisk. Uniform expansion follows by inverse time. Checked the mixed-direction logarithmic coefficient construction for k=1..99; numerical tests are not infinite proofs.
